idx_builds_project_github_run_id.name: idx_builds_project_github_run_id
idx_builds_project_github_run_id.where: "builds"."github_run_id" IS NOT NULL AND "builds"."github_run_attempt" IS NOT NULL AND "builds"."status" IN ('starting', 'building', 'deploying')

email_domains_platform_token_check.name: email_domains_platform_token_check
email_domains_platform_token_check.value: ("email_domains"."credential_kind" = 'platform' AND "email_domains"."token_ciphertext" IS NULL AND "email_domains"."token_iv" IS NULL AND "email_domains"."token_key_version" IS NULL) OR ("email_domains"."credential_kind" <> 'platform' AND "email_domains"."token_ciphertext" IS NOT NULL AND "email_domains"."token_iv" IS NOT NULL AND "email_domains"."token_key_version" IS NOT NULL)

projects_preview_identity.name: projects_preview_identity
projects_preview_identity.value: ("projects"."preview_client_id" IS NULL AND "projects"."preview_workspace_id" IS NULL AND "projects"."preview_expires_at" IS NULL) OR ("projects"."preview_client_id" IS NOT NULL AND "projects"."preview_workspace_id" IS NOT NULL AND "projects"."preview_expires_at" IS NOT NULL AND "projects"."slug" LIKE 'preview-%')

email_credentials_material_check.name: email_credentials_material_check
email_credentials_material_check.value: ("email_credentials"."kind" = 'platform' AND "email_credentials"."ciphertext" IS NULL AND "email_credentials"."iv" IS NULL AND "email_credentials"."key_version" IS NULL) OR ("email_credentials"."kind" = 'api_token' AND "email_credentials"."ciphertext" IS NOT NULL AND "email_credentials"."iv" IS NOT NULL AND "email_credentials"."key_version" IS NOT NULL)

email_domain_routes_assignment_check.name: email_domain_routes_assignment_check
email_domain_routes_assignment_check.value: ("email_domain_routes"."addressing" = 'custom' AND "email_domain_routes"."project_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("email_domain_routes"."addressing" = 'shared' AND "email_domain_routes"."project_id" IS NULL)
